Seven items are `ready`; two are `escalated`. The registered M3 draft supplies a C¹ local graph; the consuming proof derives the needed C² regularity, but remains escalated pending independent proof review. The registered M2 item proves a different, second-order local-minimum result, so the planned concave maximum/Hessian claim remains conditional. The tagged-scaling versus same-tag homogeneity conflict, including its effect on the later Euler/Gibbs-Duhem claim, is documented for the owner.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (9 items, 21 steps), proof contracts (9/9), coverage (2 pages, 32 results), source fetch (4 active stamps; 6/6 resolved), content policy, dependency checks, and rendering. Active full-text treatments include [Tong’s Chapter 1](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/statphys/statmechhtml/S1.html) and [Arovas’s Chapter 2](https://courses.physics.ucsd.edu/2025/Spring/physics210a/LECTURES/CH02.pdf).

Run-wide dependency checks and the Step 1 loader are blocked by unrelated malformed `qft-mf03` manifest entries and other scaffold/stale-level errors. I recorded and hash-verified the nine Step 1 decisions using a temporary mirror of the current dependency batches, then copied the records back; no escalation was overwritten and no owner override was used. These authoring records are not independent approval.
